svg.aria-label: How to write weil: 4 letters, w, e, i, l, one after another
svg.title: Writing weil
svg.desc: 4 letters written one after another: w, e, i, l (latin). Each letter has its own group of frames; frame N of a group shows movements 1 to N of that letter, the movement being added drawn in ink over the finished letter, whose outline is read from _fonts/NotoSansDevanagari-Static.ttf. Each letter is drawn at its own scale from its own cited stroke order, so the strip does not show how large the letters are next to each other, how far apart they sit, or any join between them. Stroke order: w: Grundschrift-App (Laborschule Bielefeld, Bielefeld University, with the Grundschulverband), level kleinbuchstaben/w, ordered stroke paths for w (assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/w/metadata.json, commit f6dbd80; no licence, facts only) <https://github.com/Medien-Treibhaus/grundschrift-app-source/blob/f6dbd807adbb3fc2f94207fe578def439f6e9c49/assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/w/metadata.json>; e: Grundschrift-App (Laborschule Bielefeld, Bielefeld University, with the Grundschulverband), level kleinbuchstaben/e, ordered stroke paths for e (assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/e/metadata.json, commit f6dbd80; no licence, facts only) <https://github.com/Medien-Treibhaus/grundschrift-app-source/blob/f6dbd807adbb3fc2f94207fe578def439f6e9c49/assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/e/metadata.json>; i: Grundschrift-App (Laborschule Bielefeld, Bielefeld University, with the Grundschulverband), level kleinbuchstaben/i, ordered stroke paths for i (assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/i/metadata.json, commit f6dbd80; no licence, facts only) <https://github.com/Medien-Treibhaus/grundschrift-app-source/blob/f6dbd807adbb3fc2f94207fe578def439f6e9c49/assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/i/metadata.json>; l: Grundschrift-App (Laborschule Bielefeld, Bielefeld University, with the Grundschulverband), level kleinbuchstaben/l, ordered stroke paths for l (assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/l/metadata.json, commit f6dbd80; no licence, facts only) <https://github.com/Medien-Treibhaus/grundschrift-app-source/blob/f6dbd807adbb3fc2f94207fe578def439f6e9c49/assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/l/metadata.json>. Source notes on variation: w: The Grundschrift-App was made in a research project of the Laborschule at Bielefeld University with the Grundschulverband, on its Grundschrift school model, with a teacher advisory team. Each letter is an ordered list of paths, one per pen-down stroke, which the app makes a child trace in order. It writes w in one stroke from the top left: down, up, down and up. UJIpenchars2 (Prat, Castro, Llorens, Marzal and Vilar; UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 177, CC BY 4.0) holds 120 tablet pen traces of w, two by each of 60 adult Spanish writers; only counts are cited. 88 of the 120 are one stroke (31 lift once), and 74 of those 88 start at the top left. The app's repository has no licence, so only the order, the start, the direction and the lifts are taken from it; no point is copied, and the path is fitted to the Noto Sans w bundled in NotoSansDevanagari-Static.ttf. Handwriting varies by writer. e: The Grundschrift-App was made in a research project of the Laborschule at Bielefeld University with the Grundschulverband, on its Grundschrift school model, with a teacher advisory team. Each letter is an ordered list of paths, one per pen-down stroke, which the app makes a child trace in order. It writes e in one stroke: from the middle left along the bar to the right, then anticlockwise up, over, down and round to the lower right. UJIpenchars2 (Prat, Castro, Llorens, Marzal and Vilar; UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 177, CC BY 4.0) holds 120 tablet pen traces of e, two by each of 60 adult Spanish writers; only counts are cited. All 120 are one stroke; 90 start at the middle left, and all 120 turn anticlockwise. The app's repository has no licence, so only the order, the start, the direction and the lifts are taken from it; no point is copied, and the path is fitted to the Noto Sans e bundled in NotoSansDevanagari-Static.ttf. Handwriting varies by writer. i: The Grundschrift-App was made in a research project of the Laborschule at Bielefeld University with the Grundschulverband, on its Grundschrift school model, with a teacher advisory team. Each letter is an ordered list of paths, one per pen-down stroke, which the app makes a child trace in order. It writes i in two strokes: the stem first, from the top down, and the dot last. Grundschrift ends the stroke with a small hook to the right that Noto Sans does not print, so the path ends where the printed letter ends. UJIpenchars2 (Prat, Castro, Llorens, Marzal and Vilar; UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 177, CC BY 4.0) holds 120 tablet pen traces of i, two by each of 60 adult Spanish writers; only counts are cited. 115 of the 120 are two strokes, and in all 115 the dot, the shorter stroke, comes last. The app's repository has no licence, so only the order, the start, the direction and the lifts are taken from it; no point is copied, and the path is fitted to the Noto Sans i bundled in NotoSansDevanagari-Static.ttf. Handwriting varies by writer. l: The Grundschrift-App was made in a research project of the Laborschule at Bielefeld University with the Grundschulverband, on its Grundschrift school model, with a teacher advisory team. Each letter is an ordered list of paths, one per pen-down stroke, which the app makes a child trace in order. It writes l in one stroke, down from the top. Grundschrift ends the stroke with a small hook to the right that Noto Sans does not print, so the path ends where the printed letter ends. UJIpenchars2 (Prat, Castro, Llorens, Marzal and Vilar; UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 177, CC BY 4.0) holds 120 tablet pen traces of l, two by each of 60 adult Spanish writers; only counts are cited. All 120 are one stroke, the source's count, but 93 of them start at the bottom left and loop up, as a joined hand does; 9 start at the top left, as the school model does. The app's repository has no licence, so only the order, the start, the direction and the lifts are taken from it; no point is copied, and the path is fitted to the Noto Sans l bundled in NotoSansDevanagari-Static.ttf. Handwriting varies by writer.
